reference_repository.use: Cross-check and parsed NSE notice tables through 2026-05-15. Not copied blindly because inferred snapshot closures and global ticker canonicalization can distort event dates.

anchor: Current data/indices/*.csv on 2026-10-02, with all DUMMY* placeholders excluded from tradeable membership.

events.notes: Nifty 50 has no replacement. Microcap 250 has 63 additions and 62 tradeable exclusions because the Allcargo/DUMMYALCAR treatment is special; the 2025-12-31 baseline therefore has 249 tradeable names and becomes 250 on this effective date.
Symbol continuity, not an index exit. Owner-confirmed name/ticker change; recorded as a symbol swap to preserve date-specific tickers.
Corporate-action placeholders excluded from tradable membership arrays.
Real listed symbols are represented from listing until the applicable official exclusion; DUMMYVEDL* placeholders are never counted.
Official replacements: Smallcap 250 JBCHEPHARM -> PFOCUS; Microcap 250 PFOCUS -> GRINDWELL; Total Market JBCHEPHARM -> GRINDWELL.
HEG Graphite Ltd. is a demerged entity, not a simple ticker rename.

alias_notes.notes: Continuity across rename. The 2026-09-30 TSFINV removal from Microcap 250 is an official review exit, not a rename inference.
Continuity across rename. The September JSWDULUX removal remains a genuine official review event.
The canonical NSE symbol used in the data is AKZOINDIA; it is treated as the same ticker/name continuity chain, not a separate membership event.
